headline: Operating profit more than doubles from a year ago
summary_short: Kakao Pay reported Q3 consolidated operating profit of ₩32.5B, up about 105% y/y, and net profit of ₩32.9B, up 71.7%.
summary_long: EPS was ₩228, up 103.6% y/y from ₩112 but down 23.0% from ₩296 last quarter. Kakao Pay Securities earned revenue of ₩74.6B and operating profit of ₩15.7B; Kakao Pay Insurance revenue was ₩32.2B, up 93%.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Profit figures are from Korean press coverage of the Nov. 3, 2026 results; consolidated revenue was not confirmed from a primary source and is omitted. EPS comparisons are from the shard, whose event date is Nov. 12.
